what.text: This page follows refugees from Ethiopia living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5016 Ethiopian refugees in France, 3.1% of all refugees from Ethiopia.
Sudan hosts the most Ethiopian refugees, followed by Kenya, Uganda and South Africa.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Ethiopia with the TPLF from 2020 to 2022, and over the government and Amhara territory with Fano from 2023 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over Oromiya territory in periods from 1990 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 338 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
